meta.name: vercel-cli
meta.description: Deploy apps to Vercel. Use when asked to deploy, ship, or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, and environment variables.

copy.tagline: 把网页应用发布到 Vercel，管理域名和环境变量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你经常要把网站部署到 Vercel 并管理其设置
copy.tagline_en: Deploy web apps to Vercel and manage domains and env vars
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly deploy websites to Vercel and manage their settings.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 能用 vercel 命令把网页应用部署到 Vercel,也能管理项目、域名和环境变量。部署后它会先检查构建、部署状态和线上 URL,确认正常才把链接给你。
howto.when: 当你要求部署或发布网页应用,或管理 Vercel 项目、域名、环境变量时,这个技能会接管,执行相应的 vercel 命令。

say.text: 帮我把当前文件夹部署到 Vercel 生产环境。
say.note: Claude 会先本地构建,再运行部署命令。

say.text: 列出我所有的 Vercel 项目。
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel project ls。

say.text: 把 example.com 加到当前项目的域名里。
say.note: Claude 会运行 vercel domains add。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude deploy web apps to Vercel using the vercel CLI, and manage projects, domains, and environment variables. After deploying, it checks the build, deployment status, and live URL before sharing the link.
howto.when_en: Activates when you ask to deploy or publish a web application, or manage Vercel projects, domains, or environment variables.

say_en.text: Deploy the current folder to Vercel production.
say_en.note: Claude will run a local build then deploy.

say_en.text: Add example.com to the current project's domains.
